description: This file defines an interface EnforcementProvider within the package org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement. It provides method signatures for creating enforcement logic, checking applicability, and converting enforcement into Akka stream graphs, specifically for enforcing commands of type T extending Signal. The interface also includes default methods for common behaviors related to enforcement processing and stream creation.

classes.name: EnforcementProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing enforcement logic for command signals, capable of generating enforcement tasks and integrating with Akka streams.

methods.name: getCommandClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of commands this provider enforces.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Default method to determine if the provider is applicable for a specific command.

methods.name: createEnforcement
methods.description: Creates an enforcement instance based on the provided context.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Determines if a given signal affects authorization state.

methods.name: createEnforcementTask
methods.description: Generates an Akka stream graph for enforcement tasks, optionally incorporating pre-enforcement steps.

methods.name: buildEnforcementTask
methods.description: Constructs an enforcement task from a context, encapsulating enforcement logic.

methods.name: mapToHandledClass
methods.description: Attempts to cast a message object to the command class T, if applicable and relevant.
